town.text: Sit down, dearie. I've waited a hundred years, I can wait while you sit.
Warm hands and empty heads. Ask yourself why, dearie.
The river remembers. Ask it nicely and it might tell you.
You've the right sort of face for questions. Ask me a better one.
Oh, never get old, dearie. It's dreadful. Wouldn't miss it, mind.
town.direction: a cackle that turns into a cough

town.text: Mind the bank. It's softer than it was. Everything's softer than it was.
Never touched a shard. Not once. That's why there's still all of me.
Spears at the ford, dearie. The river's seen it before. It never likes it.
Goblins and valley folk at one fire. I lived to see it. Never thought I would.
